**Security Mode Command: no NIA0, capabilities replayed**

| | |
|---|---|
| Group | TS 33.501 / Requirements on the AMF / Signalling data integrity |
| Tags | security |
| Verdict class | FAIL |
| Requires | Rel-15 |
| Up to | 50s at the default `--per-test-timeout` |
| Phase | main |
| Needs | NG Setup, registration |

## Clauses

- TS 33.501 5.5.2 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 reads only "shall be integrity-protected"; the NIA-0 exclusion appears in V15.1.0 and is unchanged through V19.7.0)
- TS 33.501 6.7.2 step 1b (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0: unnumbered, "selected NAS algorithm", and adds the N2-handover input container; step 1b from V15.1.0; current wording from V15.2.0; the replayed UE security capabilities are required in every version)
- TS 33.501 6.7.1.1 (Rel-15 onward, wording unchanged through Rel-19)
- TS 33.501 5.2.3 (Rel-15 onward, wording unchanged through Rel-19)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NAS-SMC-NO-NIA0-REPLAYED-CAPS.md).
